Render Quarto presentations

Source: R/presentations.R
render_presentation.Rd

Calls quarto::quarto_render() on the slides of each presentation. The HTML file is written next to the .qmd.

Usage

render_presentation(
  name = NULL,
  path = ".",
  output_format = NULL,
  quiet = FALSE,
  output_dir = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

name

Presentation folder names, relative to path. By default, every presentation found in path (see list_presentations()).

path

Folder containing the presentation folders.

output_format

Output format passed to Quarto, e.g. "revealjs", "beamer" (PDF, see the formats argument of create_presentation()) or "pptx" (PowerPoint: add a pptx: format with a reference-doc to the YAML header of the slides to use the masks of a PowerPoint template). NULL renders the formats of the slides.

quiet

Whether to suppress Quarto output.

output_dir

Folder where the rendered files are copied, in a sub-folder per presentation (<output_dir>/<name>/): the HTML slides as index.html and the PDF and PowerPoint files, if there are some, as <name>.pdf and <name>.pptx. NULL leaves the files next to the .qmd. Used by build_site().

...

Other arguments passed to quarto::quarto_render().

Value

The paths of the rendered files (.html, .pdf for output_format = "beamer" or .pptx for output_format = "pptx"), invisibly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
create_presentation("seminaire")
render_presentation("seminaire")
} # }
